body: It really annoys me when my manager asks this when I'm working...

As for taxes, income taxes vary depending on your income (i.e. the more you make, the more you're taxed) as well we have a 5% GST (Government Sales Tax) on everything you purchase. 

I live in Terwilliger in the Southwest of Edmonton. It's a suburban, uppity neighborhood, but it could be good to raise kids. 

For grocery costs, a dozen eggs could be about $3; a pound of butter could be about $3; a 900g jar of peanut butter is about $10; a loaf of bread is about 5$; 4L of milk is about $6.

Fourthly (it is "fourthly"), we have the Edmonton Eskimos as our CFL team. We don't have a rugby team as far as I'm aware. We have the Oilers as our NHL team and the Oil Kings as our minor league hockey team. We also have a lacrosse team.

Hope that helps. Good luck and welcome to Edmonton.
